candidate.definition_en: To put off to a later time; postpone.
candidate.explanation_ar: يعني تأجل حاجة لوقت تاني.. زي تأجيل الدفع أو القرار، وتأتي أحياناً بمعنى النزول عند رأي شخص آخر احتراماً له.

senses.definition_en: To put off to a later time; postpone.
senses.definition_ar: يؤجل أو يرجئ عملاً أو قراراً إلى وقت لاحق.
examples: They decided to defer the meeting until next week.
Customers may choose to defer payment for up to six months.

senses.definition_en: To yield or submit respectfully to the opinion, judgment, or wishes of another.
senses.definition_ar: ينزل عند رأي شخص آخر أو يخضع لحكمه احتراماً وتقديراً له.
examples: I will defer to your greater knowledge on this subject.
They decided to defer the meeting until next week.
Customers may choose to defer payment for up to six months.
I will defer to your greater knowledge on this subject.
candidate.mnemonic: كلمة 'Defer' قريبة من 'Different'.. هعملها في وقت 'Different' 'تاني'.. يعني بأجلها
